title: CSS-Only Accordion
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Write a complete HTML file with embedded CSS for an accordion with 3 sections using only CSS. Use hidden radio inputs and labels. Clicking a section label should expand its `.content` using a `max-height` transition. Only one section can be open at a time. Sections should have a border-bottom and padding, and the active label should become bold with a different background color.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Return a single HTML file with embedded CSS
- Use hidden radio inputs with the same `name`
- Use a smooth `max-height` transition
- Allow only one section open at a time
- Style the active label differently

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
